#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
using namespace std;

const int MOD = 998244353;

int add(int a, int b) {
    int c = a + b;
    if (c >= MOD) return c - MOD;
    if (c < 0) return c + MOD;
    return c;
}

int mult(int a, int b) {
    return (int)((long long)a * b % MOD);
}

struct Task {
    vector<vector<int>> stirling;
    void pre() {
        stirling.assign(5001, vector<int>(5001, 0));
        for (int i = 0; i <= 5000; i++) stirling[i][i] = 1;
        for (int i = 2; i <= 5000; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j < i; j++) {
                stirling[i][j] = add(mult(stirling[i-1][j], i-1), stirling[i-1][j-1]);
            }
        }
    }
    void solve(int n, int m, int k) {
        pre();
        long long invm = 1, base = m, exp = MOD - 2;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if (exp & 1) invm = (invm * base) % MOD;
            base = (base * base) % MOD;
            exp >>= 1;
        }
        vector<int> pVal(5001, 0);
        pVal[0] = 1;
        int md = n;
        int prp = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= k; i++) {
            prp = mult(mult(prp, md), (int)invm);
            md = add(md, -1);
            int sub = prp;
            for (int j = i - 1; j >= 1; j--) {
                int term = mult(stirling[i][j], pVal[j]);
                if ((i - j) % 2 == 1) {
                    sub = add(sub, term);
                } else {
                    sub = add(sub, -term);
                }
            }
            pVal[i] = sub;
        }
        cout << pVal[k] << endl;
    }
};

int main() {
    int n, m, k;
    cin >> n >> m >> k;
    Task t;
    t.solve(n, m, k);
    return 0;
}
